title: How a Leading Commercial Bank in Vietnam Increased Recovery Rates to 3.2% with Process Optimization
summary: Discover how Concentrix helped a top commercial bank in Vietnam improve recovery rates through optimized interest exemption workflows and customer-centric collections strategies.
body_markdown:
One of Vietnam’s leading commercial banks faced challenges in improving its recovery rate (ROR) across a large volume of overdue retail credit accounts.


The existing interest exemption and reduction processes were time-consuming and lacked flexibility, slowing down negotiation cycles with customers. This reduced the bank’s ability to close repayment agreements efficiently and impacted overall recovery performance.


The bank needed a more agile, scalable approach that could accelerate decision-making while maintaining a positive and compliant customer experience.
